rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a frog.

example.english: We saw a frog jumping on a lotus leaf in the park pond.
example.traditional: 我哋喺公園個池塘見到一隻青蛙喺荷葉上跳。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 gung1 jyun4 go3 ci4 tong4 gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 cing1 waa1 hai2 ho4 jip6 soeng6 tiu3

rows.note: A speaker may use this colloquial alternative for a frog, especially in casual speech.

example.english: Don't touch that frog; it'll jump away!
example.traditional: 你唔好掂嗰隻蛤乸呀，佢會跳走㗎！
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 dim3 go2 zek3 gaap3 naa2 aa3 keoi5 wui5 tiu3 zau2 gaa3

rows.note: This is a less common colloquial alternative for the same general frog sense.

example.english: The kids caught a frog by the field.
example.traditional: 細路仔喺田邊捉到隻蛤𧊅。
example.jyutping: sai3 lou6 zai2 hai2 tin4 bin1 zuk1 dou2 zek3 gaap3 gwaai2
